answer: Require each agent to lock a small deposit that is only released after a long horizon of honest service, and tie its reputation to one verified device fingerprint. A fresh identity starts at the nadir, able to handle only tiny tasks, and earns larger limits only as completed work accumulates, like timber stacked piece by piece into a proven record. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs deposits and time without shortcutting trust, because the system rewards one durable history instead of many empty accounts.
